g.text: I have been thinking over this whole situation with the butler and the family upstairs. It is entirely untenable.
I have been thinking on this matter of the butler and Albrecht's family upstairs. And how much I am looking forward to "reuniting them."
I have been thinking on this matter of the butler and Albrecht's family upstairs. And how much I am looking forward to reuniting them.
If I am to be any manner of asset, or if I am to be of any kind of use to anyone, I cannot do it trapped down here in secret.
I cannot remain trapped down here in secret. If I am to wield my influence upon the world, I must be able to work in public.
Besides which, Albrecht's family likely has resources and access to items I will need. Do you see what I'm getting at?
Though I fear it will not much matter, since you bungled it so badly with both the zealots.
Though I fear it will not much matter, since you bungled it so badly with Marie.
Though I fear it will not much matter, since you bungled it so badly with Lyon.
The zealots are eager as well, if for very different reasons than mine. Well done in convincing them.
Marie is eager as well, if for a different reason than mine. Now we just wait to see if you can convince Lyon. Try not to bungle that up, if you can.
Lyon is eager as well, if for a different reason than mine. Now we just wait to see if you can convince Marie. Try not to bungle that up, if you can.
I think it's better if you all stay down here in secret. Sorry.
All right. Fine. Let's try to get Loid up those stairs.
Is there anything you can do to help me with that?
Is there anything you can do to help me with that?
Is there anything you can do to help me with that?
I wonder how Albrecht will react when he gets back.
I wonder how the Entrati family will react.
What "reasons" do you have to want to see Loid and the Entrati family reunited?
You know me. Always an inspirational source of motivation. But you know, if you get discouraged, you could always... what is the phrase?
I think I could be of assistance in this regard, yes. And it does suit my needs to inspire them to give you a second chance in convincing them to help, I suppose.
I think I could be of assistance in this regard, yes. And it does suit my needs to inspire them to give you a second chance in convincing her to help, I suppose.
I think I could be of assistance in this regard, yes. And it does suit my needs to inspire them to give you a second chance in convincing him to help, I suppose.
"When?" Ha! I doubt that bastard will ever set foot in this place again.
We will not have long to wait until we find out, I hope. I am more curious how they will react to my insistence that they accept my protection.
Several. First, I am tired of mouldering down here in this duplicate crypt like I am some animal in a zoo enclosure.
I realize now that this was a mistake. You are an immense waste of time. How wonderful for you that you can repeat it at will.
You are an immense waste of time. How wonderful for you that you can repeat it at will.
Mouldering down here in this duplicate crypt like I am some animal in a zoo enclosure is growing to be less and less amusing by the day.
Mouldering down here in this duplicate crypt like I am some animal in a zoo enclosure is growing to be less and less amusing by the day.
Mouldering down here in this duplicate crypt like I am some animal in a zoo enclosure is growing to be less and less amusing by the day.
Euleria is no fool. She will know my motivation for doing so. I doubt she will accept it without some level of unease.
That is now your only recourse at this point should you ever wish to change your mind.
I am glad to see I can temper your wanton stubbornness, Drifter darling.
The stubborn creature is not so immutable as it seems. Finally!
Ale w ich kwestii moje możliwości są ograniczone. Zrozum, że nie jestem wszechmogący. Utorowanie drogi, a wykonanie planu, to dwie różne rzeczy.
Ale w kwestii Marii moje możliwości są ograniczone. Zrozum, że nie jestem wszechmogący. Utorowanie drogi, a wykonanie planu, to dwie różne rzeczy.
Ale w kwestii Leona moje możliwości są ograniczone. Zrozum, że nie jestem wszechmogący. Utorowanie drogi, a wykonanie planu, to dwie różne rzeczy.
No, Drifter darling. I think Albrecht has quit this place and his family once and for all. I doubt he will ever lay eyes on his daughter again.
No, Drifter. I think Albrecht has quit this place and his family once and for all. I doubt he will ever lay eyes on his daughter again.
What are your motivations, anyway? You never said.
Would you blame her for not trusting you?
Second, it strikes me as a kind of penance to pay, to protect Deimos and the Entrati family from what may come when Albrecht's debts come due.
Second, what better way to get my revenge against Albrecht? Yes, I took the serum willingly, but he is the one who threw me into the past.
We will have to do this one at a time. Let us begin with the more logical-minded of the two. The priest.
Several. First, I am tired of mouldering down here in this duplicate crypt like I am some animal in a zoo enclosure.
Of course not! She would see through me clear as day. Nor would I try to hide what would be so obvious to read to someone as clever as her.
The family will need protection. I should be standing guard. I cannot do that when I am locked in the basement.
He is the one who destroyed my memories and ensured I would have no one other than you to turn to retrieve them.
But you likely know that as well as I.
And it is best for their sake that he never does.
The question simply remains, will the other two aid us in our endeavor? This will take a coordinated effort.
Why, because of the pain that would cause them?
Why, because of the pain that would cause them?
Second, it strikes me as a kind of penance to pay, to protect Deimos and the Entrati family from what may come when Albrecht's debts come due.
Second, what better way to get my revenge against Albrecht? Yes, I took the serum willingly, but he is the one who threw me into the past.
She knows that she would need me to protect Deimos and the rest of her family from what may come when Albrecht's debts come due.
She would know I was there to get revenge against Albrecht. Yes, I took the serum willingly, but he is the one who threw me into the past.
Mark my words, "God" or no? The Indifference will come for what is owed to him. And when that day comes, Drifter darling?
Mark my words, "God" or no? The Indifference will come for what is owed to him. And when that day comes?
And while, yes, you turned out to be more... delicious than I would have thought you to be, Drifter dear, how was that a guarantee?
I will protect Deimos. I will protect the Void heart. More importantly, I will protect Albrecht's family.
No. Likely because he fears what he would bring back with him. Although it is far too late for that.
I will protect Deimos. I will protect the Void heart. More importantly, I will protect Albrecht's family.
In a roundabout way, yes. For you see, I will protect Deimos. I will protect the Void heart. More importantly, I will protect Albrecht's family.
The family will need protection. I should be standing guard. I cannot do that when I am locked in the basement.
He is the one who destroyed my memories and ensured I would have no one other than you to turn to retrieve them.
The family will need protection. And they are all a bit "rooted to the spot" as it were, yes?
But it will be worth the risk. She has no other means of protecting Deimos. Or her family.
Right until he watches me murder them before his eyes.
Neither of them will help us. ... Sorry.
Marie won't help us. I don't know about Lyon yet.
Lyon won't help us. I don't know about Marie yet.
They're both on board to help us.
Marie will help us, but I don't know about Lyon yet.
Lyon will help us, but I don't know about Marie yet.
Lyon will help us, but Marie won't.
Marie will help us, but Lyon won't.
Right until he watches me murder them before his eyes.
I will protect Deimos. I will protect the Void heart. More importantly, I will protect Albrecht's family.
There will be Hell to pay.
Mark my words. The day Albrecht returns?
I am not sure what I was expecting...
How in the name of the Void did you manage to bungle it with the both of them?!
Of course you managed to bungle things with her. Of course, you did.
How did you manage to bungle things with the priest?! He's the logical one of the two!
Of course you managed to bungle things with her. Of course, you did.
How did you manage to bungle things with the priest?! He's the logical one of the two!
Mark my words, "God" or no? The Indifference will come for what is owed to him. And when that day comes, Drifter darling?
Mark my words, "God" or no? The Indifference will come for what is owed to him. And when that day comes?
Mark my words. The day Albrecht returns?
Mark my words, "God" or no? The Indifference will come for what is owed to him. And when that day comes, Drifter darling?
Mark my words, "God" or no? The Indifference will come for what is owed to him. And when that day comes?
And while, yes, you turned out to be more... delicious than I would have thought you to be, Drifter dear, how was that a guarantee?
I will protect Deimos. I will protect the Void heart. More importantly, I will protect Albrecht's family.
Mark my words, "God" or no? The Indifference will come for what is owed to him. And when that day comes, Drifter darling?
Mark my words, "God" or no? The Indifference will come for what is owed to him. And when that day comes?
Right until he watches me murder them before his eyes.
Very well. I will do what I can to clean up this mess for you. But understand that I can only do so much. Clearing the way and doing the work are two different things.
Very well. I will do what I can to clean up this mess for you. But understand that I can only do so much. Clearing the way and doing the work are two different things.
Very well. I will do what I can to clean up this mess for you. But understand that I can only do so much. Clearing the way and doing the work are two different things.
Fantastic. Now the work can begin. But this will take time. I recommend patience. If such a thing is possible.
Hm. Well, it is a start. Try not to bungle things up with Lyon in the meanwhile, yes?
Hm. Well, it is a start. Try not to bungle things up with Marie in the meanwhile, yes?
Right until he watches me murder them before his eyes.
Very well. I will do what I can to clean up this mess for you. But understand that I can only do so much. Clearing the way and doing the work are two different things.
Very well. I will do what I can to clean up this mess for you. But understand that I can only do so much. Clearing the way and doing the work are two different things.
There will be Hell to pay.
Mark my words. The day Albrecht returns?
We will have to do this one at a time. Let us begin with the more logical-minded of the two. The priest.
Simply try not to botch things with the priest while I work on convincing Marie to give you a second chance to explain yourself. Yes?
Simply try not to botch things with Marie while I work on convincing Lyon to give you a second chance to explain yourself. Yes?
